Requirements: A phenotype with no plausible biological link to the SNPs; an external reference for comparison
Key_assumption: Negative control unrelated to the SNPs, not in LD with them and free of pleiotropic pathways
Not_appropriate_when: Pleiotropy is so widespread that no unrelated phenotype exists

Requirements: Participant genotypes with familial (e.g. parental) outcome data
Key_assumption: Accurate familial reporting; no cohort or age effects linking SNP and proxy
Not_appropriate_when: Familial data unavailable or the trait has weak familial correlation

Requirements: A participation indicator, or a population reference for allele frequencies
Not_appropriate_when: Comparator poorly characterised or participation variable measured with error

Requirements: Measured predictors of participation; population reference data to calibrate weights
Key_assumption: Participation fully explained by measured covariates; every group has non-zero probability of inclusion
Not_appropriate_when: Key selection covariates unmeasured; extreme or unstable weights

Requirements: Covariate data on participants and non-participants; an exclusion-restriction variable
Key_assumption: Valid exclusion restriction; bivariate normal errors
Not_appropriate_when: No credible exclusion restriction or no data on non-participants

Requirements: Case-control status; secondary phenotype; population disease prevalence
Key_assumption: Correctly specified retrospective likelihood; additive genetic model
Not_appropriate_when: Recruitment not conditioned on disease (population cohorts or case-only designs)

Key_assumption: Logistic model of participation; low participation rate
Not_appropriate_when: Selection acts through factors other than sex, or participation rate is high

Requirements: Incidence and progression GWAS summary statistics
Key_assumption: Direct effects on progression independent of effects on incidence; constant bias slope

Requirements: Incidence and progression GWAS summary statistics
Key_assumption: A distinct, sufficiently large cluster of incidence-only SNPs
Not_appropriate_when: Incidence-only cluster small or poorly separated

Requirements: Incidence and progression GWAS summary statistics; prior specification
Not_appropriate_when: Many SNPs with moderate direct effects; genome-wide use without pruning
